gates.scope: Included atomic/continuum identities, hydrogenic cross-section anchors, independent mixing quadrature, finite differentiable rates and implicit charge feedback.
what_not_proved: Atomic-data accuracy, complete hydrogen atom, or H-minus chemical equilibrium.

gates.scope: For the extended nmax=20 atom at T=9000 K, nH=1e12 cm^-3, Trad=10000 K and W=0.025, continuum refinement and forward/reverse implicit population derivatives meet numerical tolerances.
what_not_proved: Numerical accuracy does not establish shell-size convergence or atomic-data accuracy.
The derivative checks use log(T) and log(nH) at one declared baseline, not a global NUTS parameter domain.

gates.scope: At T=9000 K, nH=1e12 cm^-3, Trad=10000 K and W=0.025, both n2 and n3 change by at most 5 percent from nmax=15 to 20. The explicit 5,10,15,20 sequence is also retained.
what_not_proved: The original nmax=4-to-5 criterion remains separate and is not redefined by this gate.
This sampled larger-atom criterion does not prove infinite-atom convergence, agreement with an external reference, or atmospheric validity.

limitations: Gate outcomes do not update or establish scientific Assessments.
Package metadata plus source roots are not a complete environment lock.
Only declared repository inputs are snapshotted; external dependencies are not vendored.
